title: skills(pm-dispatch, AGENTS.md): finding admission threshold — three classes file, the rest rides the PR's acceptance notes
body:
Refs #16351

The `SKILL.md` + `references/core-rules.md` + `AGENTS.md` half of the finding admission threshold. The `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` half is held by another flight on that file and rides the flight that follows it, so this PR carries `Refs`, not a closing keyword; the card stays open until that half lands.

## The rule landed — one rule, three registers

A card is filed for exactly three classes: **(a)** a reproducible defect (a repro or a failing probe named); **(b)** a violation of a declared contract (the contract text cited); **(c)** a trap that leads an AI authoring metadata to write what the runtime refuses or silently drops. Everything else — observations, dead code, drift not yet exercised, polish, style, doc nits, naming — is NOT a card: the dev lists it under a `## 验收备注` section of its PR body and in the report's `out_of_scope_findings` as `noted, not filed: …`; the seat reads it at ACCEPT and files a card itself only for an item that is in fact class (a)–(c). A filed finding outside the three classes is closed not planned in one stroke by the grading seat. The `finding` label keeps its meaning for what IS filed (待首次定级); a three-class card carries its evidence in the body, and the triage seat refuses one that carries none.

## 改前 → 改后 — every touched line, with the fold that paid for it

Line numbers are on `origin/main` at `b9a14dd64f`, the base of this branch. All three files are line-neutral — SKILL.md 811 → 811 (widest table row 342 → 342), core-rules.md 150 → 150, AGENTS.md 1058 → 1058 — and every changed line is ≤120 bytes (`LC_ALL=C awk`). Rules-only register: no dates, quotations, issue numbers or model names were added.

## 验收备注 (noted, not filed)

- `noted, not filed:` `references/dispatch-runbook.md` line 31 still reads 「范围外发现照旧单开」 in the sweep-batch context; under the rule landed here it reads as "filed per the admission threshold rather than folded into the sweep PR". A wording drift not yet exercised, outside this flight's declared file surface — not a card under this very rule.
- `noted, not filed:` the `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 范围 rule (「顺路撞见的无关缺陷立成新的无 assignee issue」 / 「观察类发现…打 `finding` 标签」) still states the old admission; it is the other half of the card, held by another flight on that file — not a finding, a known remaining half.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 把「什么样的发现才立卡」的门槛写进 PM 派发协议(SKILL.md)、它的规则摘要(core-rules.md)和仓根 AGENTS.md 的第 10 条基本纪律:只有可复现缺陷、契约违背、会让 AI 写错元数据的陷阱三类才开卡;其余观察、死代码、抛光、风格、文档小问题写进 PR 正文的「验收备注」,由复核席在验收时读,其中真属三类的由席位补立;三类之外已立的卡由定级席一笔关 not planned。三个文件行数不变,每加一行都在同一节内折一行付账。

**为什么改。** 来源是您在席位对话里的指示:两个仓库都需要 finding 准入门槛,从源头减流。看板读数是 open 卡里近半是 finding、每日新立几十张,绝大多数是 dev 顺路记下的观察,定级为 p3 后长期积压;吞吐不是问题,入流是,而入流是舰队自己按旧规则制造的。objectui 没有自己的 finding 规则,读的就是这几份文件,所以一次落地覆盖两仓。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 代价是三类之外的观察不再有卡片留痕,只留在 PR 正文里;如果 dev 把一个真缺陷判成了观察,复核席在验收时是第二道眼,这是本规则有意留下的兜底。纯文本协议改动,不动代码、不动门禁、不放宽任何 ratchet;回滚就是 revert 本 PR。os-dev.md 那一半由另一趟落地,落地前 dev 侧读到的仍是旧规则,PM 侧已按新规则读报告,这段窗口里两侧不一致但不冲突(PM 只会多关、不会少收)。

**席位意见。** (留空)

**你要做的。** 批准并合并本 PR;若认为三类的边界应放宽或收紧,回复要调整的那一类即可。
